definition: An independent coordinate needed to describe an event in a specified spacetime model.

temporal.was: Historical descriptions of space and time used various mathematical frameworks.
temporal.is: General relativity models spacetime with three spatial and one temporal coordinate.
temporal.might_become: Future measurements could constrain proposed additional physical dimensions.

assumptions: Dimensionality is defined relative to a mathematical model.

alternatives.label: Additional compact spatial dimensions
alternatives.definition: Some theoretical models introduce extra spatial coordinates.
alternatives.distinguishing_test: Demonstrate a reproducible observation that differentiates predictions from four-dimensional models.

open_questions: Do additional physical spatial dimensions exist?
